scheme_name: Bihar Shatabdi Asangathit Karyakshetra Kamagaar Evan Shilpakar Samajik Suraksha Yojana: Medical Assistance for Incurable Diseases
other_conditions: The applicant must work in the unorganized sector within Bihar.
Age is calculated as of 1st July of any year.
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance of ₹7,500 to ₹30,000 for medical treatment of incurable diseases.
